findings.statement: The Mississippi Secretary of State business entity search at corp.sos.ms.gov/corpbusinessidx returned an HTTP 403 Cloudflare block interstitial to automated access, so no registration record for Sterling Trading Company in Mississippi could be confirmed or ruled out, and the registry was not retried. No Mississippi registration or licence record for this name surfaced through open web search either. MCC 5947 retail of novelty goods does not imply a state-level professional licence requirement, so no separate licence register was applicable.
findings.establishes: Legal existence of the registered entity in Mississippi could not be tested because the official registry blocks automated access.

findings.statement: No independent listing of any kind places Sterling Trading Company in Grenada, Mississippi. Repeated searches found no Google, Yelp, Facebook, Instagram, Nextdoor or BBB entry for the business in Grenada or anywhere in Mississippi, and the only similarly named entities found are unrelated firms in Chicago IL, Sterling CO and Doha QA. The merchant's own site gives no Grenada address: its sole location block displays a San Francisco, CA address with an Oakland, CA map pin. The site's About copy says customers should follow a Facebook page to learn where and when a tent will be open, implying a pop-up retail presence, but no such Facebook page could be located. A retail novelty-goods seller with a stated physical city therefore has no observable independent footprint in that city.
findings.establishes: The business has no independent public presence tying it to the stated operating city of Grenada, MS.

findings.statement: The representative does not match any named owner, officer or staff member on the merchant's own website, whose home, About and Contact pages name no individual at all; no Mississippi state filing could be retrieved because the registry blocked automation, and no licence record, review-site owner reply, social page, local news item or complaint report naming the representative in connection with this business was found. Equally, nothing was found that contradicts the representative's connection to the business or ties the representative to a different company or to fraud reports. Identity documents and bank ownership are verified only by Stripe (status: verified).
findings.establishes: No public corroboration or contradiction of the representative's link to the business; reliance falls back on Stripe's own verification.

findings.statement: The domain resolves and the site returns HTTP 200 as a live Square Online storefront titled 'Home | Sterling Trading Company', with og:site_name 'Sterling Trading Company' and the merchant's own email handle embedded, so the site does belong to this business and the statement descriptor STERLINGTRADINGCOMPANY and the email domain cohere with the legal name. However the published contact details are fictitious: the About page's Location & Hours block lists a San Francisco, CA street address with telephone 512-555-0126, a number inside the 555-0100 to 555-0199 block reserved by NANPA for fictional use, while the embedded map is pinned to a separate Oakland, CA address. Neither address is in Grenada, MS or anywhere in Mississippi, and the contact form still carries the unedited Square Online theme notice that the form is for demo purposes only and submissions will not be answered. The business therefore publishes no reachable, genuine address or phone.
findings.establishes: The website is genuinely the merchant's but publishes template-default, fictitious and out-of-state contact information, leaving no verifiable way to reach the business.

findings.statement: MCC 5947 (gift, novelty and souvenir shops) is coherent with an observable, well-populated product catalogue. The site's sitemap lists roughly forty live product pages plus two shop categories named 'squishies' and 'jewelry', covering sensory squeeze toys and crunchy squishies, mini squishy blind bags and mystery boxes, beaded and rope necklaces, pink ribbon hair bows, breast-cancer-awareness eye black temporary tattoos, cooling towels, spooky squishy key rings and a 36-piece sunglasses counter display. These are physical novelty, gift and impulse-retail goods, exactly the merchandise class MCC 5947 describes, and a dedicated state-tournament orders page is consistent with event and sports-tournament novelty vending. The statement descriptor is the business name, not a random string, and nothing in the name or catalogue describes payment collection rather than a trade.
findings.establishes: The assigned MCC and descriptor match the goods the merchant observably sells.

findings.statement: No dated independent evidence of trading history was found: no reviews on any platform, no directory or BBB listing, no local news coverage, no retrievable state filing and no scam, fraud or complaint reports naming this business or its representative. The only dated artefacts are self-published: every page and product in the site's own sitemap carries a lastmod of 2026-10-08, roughly three weeks before the Stripe account connected on 2026-10-30, which indicates a recently built storefront rather than an established presence. There is therefore no basis to establish independent presence of one year or more, and equally no adverse history was found.
findings.establishes: No independent trading history of any length, and no adverse reports; the only datable footprint is a self-published site about three weeks old at onboarding.

evidenceNeeded: Manual browser search of the Mississippi Secretary of State business registry at corp.sos.ms.gov/corpbusinessidx for 'Sterling Trading Company' and variants, plus an officer/registered-agent search, since the registry blocks automated access.

Documentary proof of a genuine Grenada, MS business address and a working business telephone, replacing the Square Online template defaults (San Francisco address, Oakland map pin, reserved-fictitious 512-555-0126 number) currently published on the site.
The Facebook page the merchant's own About copy directs customers to, to confirm the tent/pop-up retail presence, posting history and page administration.
Confirmation of the state-tournament vending arrangement named on the site, e.g. a vendor agreement or event organiser confirmation, as the only claimed local commercial relationship.
Evidence linking the account representative to the business in a documentary capacity (state filing officer entry, Grenada MS privilege licence, supplier account, or premises lease).
summary: Sterling Trading Company operates a live, well-stocked Square Online storefront selling squishies, sensory toys, costume jewellery, hair bows and similar impulse goods, so MCC 5947 and the STERLINGTRADINGCOMPANY descriptor are clearly coherent with the observable trade. The material concerns are locational and contactability rather than product legitimacy: the site publishes template-default, fictitious contact details (an out-of-state address, a separate Oakland map pin, a NANPA reserved-fictitious phone number and an unedited 'demo purposes only' contact form), and no Google, Yelp, Facebook, Instagram or BBB listing places the business in Grenada, MS or anywhere in Mississippi. The Mississippi Secretary of State registry returned a Cloudflare 403 and could not be checked, so legal existence remains untested, and the representative appears on no public source tied to the business, though nothing contradicts it and Stripe reports the entity verified with payouts enabled. Total risk 20 points, concentrated in operating footprint and contactability; next steps are a manual state-registry check and documentary proof of a real Grenada address and working phone before treating the Mississippi location as established.
